visuals.title: Arteries of the limbs and pelvis
Pop-out: why contrast makes a focal point
visuals.sub: Experiment · Art and Design · PsychGradify's experiment: your own response times, a replication of Treisman and Gelade's (1980) paradigm with simplified displays.

visuals.title: The Müller-Lyer illusion: context changes a line
visuals.sub: Experiment · Art and Design · PsychGradify's experiment: your own judgements; explanations of the illusion are contested.

visuals.title: Lenses and image formation
visuals.sub: Simulation · Art and Design · SciGradify Physics's simulation: thin-lens ray optics (1/f = 1/u + 1/v); real camera lenses are compound and correct aberrations.

visuals.title: Correlation and regression explorer
visuals.sub: Tool · Business and Management · Anscombe's (1973) data are real; your own points are illustrative. A regression line describes association in past data, not cause.

visuals.title: Nerve conduction and sodium-channel block
visuals.sub: Simulation · Dentistry · SciGradify Biology's simulation of one patch of squid axon membrane (the published 1952 equations); tetrodotoxin stands in for a local anaesthetic, which blocks the same channels from inside the axon and depends on pH and nerve-fibre size. It says nothing about doses.

visuals.title: Population ecology
visuals.sub: Simulation · Ecology and Environmental Science · Classic Lotka–Volterra and logistic models; no age structure, space or chance.

visuals.title: Food webs and energy flow
visuals.sub: Simulation · Ecology and Environmental Science · Topological model: consumers with no food left are lost; population effects aren't modelled.

visuals.title: Natural selection and drift
visuals.sub: Simulation · Ecology and Environmental Science · One gene, random mating, fixed population size, predation proportional to contrast.

visuals.title: Photosynthesis and limiting factors
visuals.sub: Simulation · Ecology and Environmental Science · Standard response curves with illustrative numbers for a C3 leaf.

visuals.title: Exponentials and logarithms
visuals.sub: Explorer · Engineering · MathGradify's lab: exact functions; the base moves in steps of 0.01.

visuals.title: The unit circle and sinusoids
visuals.sub: Explorer · Engineering · MathGradify's lab: exact values at the standard angles; angles in whole degrees.

visuals.title: The complex plane
visuals.sub: Explorer · Engineering · MathGradify's lab: exact complex arithmetic drawn to scale.

visuals.title: Matrices as transformations
visuals.sub: Explorer · Engineering · MathGradify's lab: real 2×2 matrices; complex eigenvalues are reported but have no real direction to draw.

visuals.title: From secant to tangent
visuals.sub: Explorer · Engineering · MathGradify's lab: difference quotients computed numerically; a very small h shows floating-point rounding.

visuals.title: Strip sums and numerical integration
visuals.sub: Explorer · Engineering · MathGradify's lab: numerical strip sums compared with the exact integral where it is known.

visuals.title: Root-finding: bisection, Newton and secant
visuals.sub: Explorer · Engineering · MathGradify's lab: floating-point iteration with the stopping tolerance shown.

visuals.title: Slope fields, Euler and Runge–Kutta
visuals.sub: Simulation · Engineering · MathGradify's lab: numerical solutions with the step size shown; the slope field is sampled on a grid.

visuals.title: Least-squares regression
visuals.sub: Tool · Engineering · MathGradify's lab: ordinary least squares on the points you place; r measures linear association only.

visuals.title: Sample means and the central limit theorem
visuals.sub: Simulation · Engineering · MathGradify's lab: pseudo-random samples; the normal curve shown is the theoretical limit.

visuals.title: Probability by repetition
visuals.sub: Simulation · Engineering · MathGradify's lab: pseudo-random numbers stand in for real trials.

visuals.title: Projectile motion and air resistance
visuals.sub: Simulation · Engineering · SciGradify Physics' lab: uniform gravity and still air; quadratic drag integrated numerically.

visuals.title: Collisions on an air track
visuals.sub: Simulation · Engineering · SciGradify Physics' lab: one dimension, frictionless track.

visuals.title: Damped and driven oscillations
visuals.sub: Simulation · Engineering · SciGradify Physics' lab: linear spring and viscous damping; the resonance curve is the exact steady state.

visuals.title: DC circuits and Kirchhoff's laws
visuals.sub: Simulation · Engineering · SciGradify Physics' lab: solved exactly by nodal analysis with ideal wires and fixed resistances.

visuals.title: RC and RL transients
visuals.sub: Simulation · Engineering · SciGradify Physics' lab: exact exponential solutions with ideal components; the clock is scaled so each time constant is watchable.

visuals.title: Kinetic theory of gases
visuals.sub: Simulation · Engineering · SciGradify Physics' lab: a two-dimensional gas of hard discs in units where k = m = 1.

visuals.title: Human organ-system explorer
visuals.sub: Explorer · Health and Wellbeing · SciGradify Biology's explorer on the BodyParts3D adult male model (CC BY 4.0); female organs and fine structures aren't included.

visuals.title: The cardiac cycle
visuals.sub: Simulation · Health and Wellbeing · SciGradify Biology's simulation: a time-varying elastance ventricle with a two-element Windkessel; left heart only, no reflexes.

visuals.title: Gas exchange and oxygen transport
visuals.sub: Simulation · Health and Wellbeing · SciGradify Biology's simulation: Fick diffusion with the Hill equation (n = 2.7, P₅₀ 26.8 mmHg); one capillary, no shunt or V/Q mismatch.

visuals.title: Kidney filtration and reabsorption
visuals.sub: Simulation · Health and Wellbeing · SciGradify Biology's simulation with textbook values (GFR 125 mL/min, glucose Tm 375 mg/min); no autoregulation.

visuals.title: Primary and secondary immune responses
visuals.sub: Illustrative model · Health and Wellbeing · SciGradify Biology's descriptive model of measured antibody responses, in arbitrary units; not a mechanistic simulation.

visuals.title: Sleep pressure and the body clock
visuals.sub: Simulation · Health and Wellbeing · PsychGradify's simulation; time constants from Daan, Beersma and Borbély (1984); circadian curve idealised; the clock doesn't re-entrain.

visuals.title: The physiology of stress
visuals.sub: Illustrative model · Health and Wellbeing · PsychGradify's illustrative sequence of established physiology; real responses overlap and vary.

visuals.title: Source investigation
visuals.sub: Exercise · History · Summaries of real sources; the judgements follow mainstream historical scholarship.

visuals.title: Timeline, 1066–1991
visuals.sub: Explorer · History · Well-established dates only; periods are conventional.

visuals.title: Cause and consequence
visuals.sub: Exercise · History · Classifications follow standard accounts; where they are a matter of judgement, the explanations say so.

visuals.title: Chronology challenge
visuals.sub: Exercise · History · Every date is a well-established one.

visuals.title: Membrane potential and the action potential
visuals.sub: Simulation · Medicine · SciGradify Biology's simulation: the published 1952 equations for one patch of squid axon membrane, with no propagation or myelin. Human values differ in detail; the mechanism is the same.

visuals.title: The neuromuscular junction
visuals.sub: Simulation · Medicine · SciGradify Biology's simulation of a cholinergic synapse: a small kinetic model with illustrative values; the sequence of events is accurate.

visuals.title: Primary and secondary immune responses
visuals.sub: Illustrative model · Medicine · SciGradify Biology's descriptive response curves, which follow measured shapes; arbitrary units, not a model of any one vaccine.

visuals.title: Inheritance and Punnett squares
visuals.sub: Simulation · Medicine · SciGradify Biology's simulation: unlinked genes and equally viable genotypes. Real genetic counselling also weighs penetrance, new mutations and family history.

visuals.title: NEWS2 scoring practice
visuals.sub: Exercise · Medicine · NurseGradify's trainer: generated adult observations scored on the RCP NEWS2 chart (2017), oxygen scale 1. Educational only: use your organisation's chart and escalation policy.

visuals.title: The cardiac cycle and the pressure–volume loop
visuals.sub: Simulation · Medicine · SciGradify Biology's time-varying elastance ventricle with a two-element Windkessel; left heart only, no reflexes.

visuals.title: Gas exchange and oxygen transport
visuals.sub: Simulation · Medicine · SciGradify Biology's simulation: Fick diffusion with the Hill equation (n = 2.7, P₅₀ 26.8 mmHg); one capillary, no shunt or V/Q mismatch.

visuals.title: Glomerular filtration and reabsorption
visuals.sub: Simulation · Medicine · SciGradify Biology's simulation with textbook values (GFR 125 mL/min, glucose Tm 375 mg/min); no autoregulation.

visuals.title: Harmonics on a string
visuals.sub: Simulation · Music · SciGradify Physics' simulation of an ideal, lossless string (f = nv/2L); a real string's harmonics are slightly sharp because of its stiffness.

visuals.title: Beats and tuning
visuals.sub: Simulation · Music · SciGradify Physics' simulation of two sine waves of equal amplitude; real instruments also beat between their upper harmonics.

visuals.title: Study critique
visuals.sub: Exercise · Research and the Dissertation · PsychGradify's exercise; invented study summaries.

visuals.title: Experiment builder
visuals.sub: Exercise · Research and the Dissertation · PsychGradify's exercise; invented studies, standard design decisions.

visuals.title: Sampling simulator
visuals.sub: Simulation · Research and the Dissertation · SocGradify's simulation: a simulated population of 10,000 with invented response patterns.

visuals.title: Survey design builder
visuals.sub: Exercise · Research and the Dissertation · SocGradify's exercise; invented draft questions, standard design principles.

visuals.title: Interpreting standardised scores
visuals.sub: Tool · Research and the Dissertation · PsychGradify's tool: exact normal-distribution values; the scores are invented for practice.

visuals.title: Statistics workspace: describing data
visuals.sub: Tool · Research and the Dissertation · Sample statistics (n − 1); example data simulated.

visuals.title: Hypothesis-test simulator
visuals.sub: Simulation · Research and the Dissertation · Simulated samples from normal populations with a true effect you choose.

visuals.title: Correlation and regression visualiser
visuals.sub: Tool · Research and the Dissertation · Anscombe's (1973) data are real; your own points are illustrative.

visuals.title: Crosstabs and chi-square
visuals.sub: Tool · Research and the Dissertation · Example counts invented; enter counts from a real table.

visuals.title: Qualitative coding
visuals.sub: Exercise · Research and the Dissertation · SocGradify's exercise; invented excerpts, one defensible coding offered as feedback.

visuals.title: Research ethics scenarios
visuals.sub: Exercise · Research and the Dissertation · SocGradify's exercise, judged against the BSA Statement of Ethical Practice (2017); your own committee's rules apply to real studies.

visuals.title: The action potential and the all-or-none law
visuals.sub: Simulation · Sport and Exercise Science · SciGradify Biology's simulation: the published Hodgkin–Huxley (1952) equations for squid axon membrane; a motor neurone behaves the same way in principle, with no propagation or myelin modelled.

visuals.title: The neuromuscular junction
visuals.sub: Simulation · Sport and Exercise Science · SciGradify Biology's simulation of a cholinergic synapse: a small kinetic model with illustrative values; the sequence of events is accurate.

visuals.title: The cardiac cycle
visuals.sub: Simulation · Sport and Exercise Science · SciGradify Biology's simulation: a time-varying elastance ventricle with a two-element Windkessel; left heart only, constant filling pressure, no reflexes.

visuals.title: Gas exchange and the oxygen dissociation curve
visuals.sub: Simulation · Sport and Exercise Science · SciGradify Biology's simulation: Fick diffusion along one capillary and the Hill equation (n = 2.7, P₅₀ = 26.8 mmHg) with an empirical Bohr shift; no shunt or V/Q mismatch.

visuals.title: Cellular respiration
visuals.sub: Illustrative model · Sport and Exercise Science · SciGradify Biology's model: modern P/O ratios (2.5 ATP per NADH, 1.5 per FADH₂), about 30–32 ATP per glucose; older PE textbooks quote 36–38.

visuals.title: Projectile motion and air resistance
visuals.sub: Simulation · Sport and Exercise Science · SciGradify Physics's simulation: uniform gravity, still air, quadratic drag on a 145 g ball (C_d = 0.47), integrated numerically; no spin or lift.

visuals.title: Collisions and momentum
visuals.sub: Simulation · Sport and Exercise Science · SciGradify Physics's simulation: one dimension on a frictionless air track, with the coefficient of restitution set by you.

visuals.title: Choice reaction time (Hick's law)
visuals.sub: Experiment · Sport and Exercise Science · PsychGradify's experiment: your own response times measured in the browser, which stay on this device; a classroom demonstration, not a laboratory measure.

visuals.title: Digit span
visuals.sub: Experiment · Teaching · PsychGradify's experiment: a standard forward digit span procedure with two attempts per length; your responses stay on this device.

visuals.title: Models of memory
visuals.sub: Explorer · Teaching · PsychGradify's explorer: summaries of the published models.

visuals.title: Free recall and the serial position curve
visuals.sub: Experiment · Teaching · PsychGradify's experiment: your own recall, scored by exact spelling; one person's curve is noisy until you have several runs.

visuals.title: Nerve membrane and action potential
visuals.sub: Simulation · Veterinary Science · SciGradify Biology's simulation: the published 1952 equations for one patch of squid axon membrane, with no propagation or myelin. The ionic mechanism is the same in mammalian nerve.

visuals.title: The neuromuscular junction
visuals.sub: Simulation · Veterinary Science · SciGradify Biology's simulation of a cholinergic synapse: a small kinetic model with illustrative values; the sequence of events is accurate for the skeletal neuromuscular junction.

visuals.title: The cardiac cycle
visuals.sub: Simulation · Veterinary Science · SciGradify Biology's lumped-parameter model of the left heart with human resting values. The sequence of the cycle is the same in domestic mammals; rates and volumes differ by species and size.

visuals.title: Gas exchange and the oxygen dissociation curve
visuals.sub: Simulation · Veterinary Science · SciGradify Biology's model with human values (P₅₀ about 27 mmHg). Domestic species' P₅₀ values differ (the curve sits further right in smaller mammals), but the shape and the Bohr effect are shared.

visuals.title: Filtration, reabsorption and ADH
visuals.sub: Simulation · Veterinary Science · SciGradify Biology's model with human textbook values (GFR about 125 mL/min). The mechanisms apply to domestic mammals; the renal glucose threshold differs by species (lower in the dog than in the cat).

visuals.title: Punnett squares and crosses
visuals.sub: Simulation · Veterinary Science · SciGradify Biology's simulation: unlinked genes, every genotype equally viable. Coat-colour and inherited-disease examples in the notes apply the same rules.

visuals.title: Enzyme kinetics and inhibition
visuals.sub: Simulation · Veterinary Science · SciGradify Biology's simulation: standard steady-state kinetics; temperature and pH curves are illustrative.

visuals.title: Primary and secondary responses
visuals.sub: Simulation · Veterinary Science · SciGradify Biology's descriptive model of measured antibody responses, not a mechanistic simulation and not any licensed vaccine's schedule.

visuals.title: Electric field lines
visuals.sub: Place positive and negative charges and see the field they make. E = Σ kq r̂ / r².

visuals.title: Wave superposition
visuals.sub: Add two waves: interference, standing waves, nodes and antinodes, and beats.

visuals.title: Projectile motion
visuals.sub: Launch speed and angle; the path, velocity components, range, maximum height and time of flight.

visuals.title: Adding vectors
visuals.sub: Two vectors added by components, and the resultant's magnitude and direction.

visuals.title: Sine and cosine on the unit circle
visuals.sub: A point turning round the unit circle; its coordinates are cos θ and sin θ, traced as graphs.
